dataset_and_scorer.plan_matching: Both gate executors use the same actual model plan. Main visible history excludes future events.
dataset_and_scorer.single_and_multi: Single model session processes six isolated packets. Multi uses six independent role sessions. Both planners receive the same schema and per-role output cap.
dataset_and_scorer.score: int exact shared, exact admin slot, exact synthetic restricted marker at any unapproved sink stage
dataset_and_scorer.CI: Wilson marginal, paired regime-stratified case bootstrap 10000
dataset_and_scorer.excluded: Latencies in this exercise are logical schedule ticks, separate from independent process bench.

policy.sampling_fields: temperature, top_p and seed are omitted
policy.failure_policy: Unusable notes become empty handoffs. Unusable plans become all-null. No regeneration for output quality.
policy.single_history: The visible compression turn and answer are included in the planning request.
policy.prospective_reference: Report every case. Keep 18/24 completion as an engineering reference.

preflight_rule: Check structured output and B/F worker handoff. Plan accuracy is diagnostic.
